What I make / 02

Every kind of video that lives under AI creation and editing.

AI video is not one thing. These are the formats I work in, what each one is for, and when it is the right choice.

AI Video Advertisements

Paid-media creative generated and edited for a specific product, offer and audience.

When you need advertising creative at the volume paid social and search demand, without a shoot for every variation.

  • Hook-led concepts
  • Multiple variations for testing
  • Platform-ready aspect ratios

AI UGC Videos

Creator-style footage that looks native to a social feed rather than produced.

When polished brand film reads as an advert and gets scrolled past.

  • Spoken-to-camera scripts
  • Natural, hand-held feel
  • Caption-first editing

AI Avatar Videos

A presenter generated from a script, able to speak in different languages and voices.

For onboarding, sales, training and explainer content where a face carries the message.

  • Presenter and voice selection
  • Script to finished delivery
  • Multi-language versions

Explainer Videos

Short, structured videos that make a product, platform or service easy to understand.

When the thing you sell takes a paragraph to explain and loses people before the end.

  • Scripting and structure
  • Motion and visual metaphor
  • Voiceover and captions

Product Commercials

Cinematic product-led storytelling with careful lighting, motion and post-production.

For launches, landing pages and anywhere the product has to look its best.

  • Concept and shot design
  • Generated or filmed footage
  • Sound design and grade

Social Media Content

Short-form content cut for the feed, built around the first two seconds.

For a steady publishing rhythm across TikTok, Reels, Shorts and LinkedIn.

  • Hook-first edits
  • Burned-in captions
  • Every platform format

Promotional Videos

Campaign, event and announcement videos with a single clear call to action.

When something specific needs attention within a defined window.

  • Campaign messaging
  • Cutdowns for each channel
  • Clear call to action

Video Editing

Post-production on footage you already have — generated, filmed or a mix of both.

When the material exists but the story, pacing and polish do not yet.

  • Story and pacing
  • Captions, graphics, grade
  • Audio clean-up and mix

The toolkit / 05

The tools behind the story, and what each one is for.

Tools do not make the video. Knowing which one to reach for, and when, is what keeps the work consistent.

AI Video Generation

  • K
    Kling AIText and image to video, used for realistic motion and cinematic shots.
  • R
    RunwayGenerative video plus editing and clean-up tools in one place.
  • G
    Google VeoText to video with synchronised audio, used for higher-fidelity sequences.

AI Avatar Creation

  • H
    HeyGenAI presenters with voice cloning and translation for multi-language versions.
  • S
    SynthesiaScript-to-presenter video, used for training, onboarding and explainers.

AI Voice Generation

  • E
    ElevenLabsVoice generation and cloning for narration and character voice.

AI Image Generation

  • M
    MidjourneyStill image generation for concept frames, thumbnails and storyboards.
  • C
    ChatGPTConcepting, scripting and copy, plus image generation for references.

Video Editing

  • C
    CapCutFast social-first editing, captions and effects for short-form.
  • A
    Adobe Premiere ProThe main edit suite for longer pieces, colour and final delivery.

Design

  • C
    CanvaGraphics, thumbnails and templates that keep a brand consistent.
  • F
    FigmaStoryboards, layout and design work before production starts.

FAQs / 09

A few things worth knowing.

What types of AI videos do you create?+

AI video advertisements, AI UGC-style videos, AI avatar videos, explainer videos, product commercials, promotional videos and short-form social media content.

Do you work with international clients?+

Yes. I am based in Lagos, Nigeria and work with clients remotely, worldwide.

Can you create videos for social media advertisements?+

Yes. Social and advertising content is a core part of the work, delivered in the aspect ratios and formats each platform requires, with captions for sound-off viewing.

Do you provide scriptwriting?+

Yes. Scriptwriting and storyboarding are offered as part of a production, or as a standalone service before production begins.

Can you create AI avatar videos?+

Yes. AI avatar videos are produced using tools such as HeyGen and Synthesia, for marketing, onboarding, sales and education content.

How does your production process work?+

Six stages: discovery, research and concept, scriptwriting, AI production, editing and refinement, then delivery in the formats you need.

How can I book a discovery call?+

Use the booking page, or send your project details through the contact form, by email or on WhatsApp and we will arrange a time.
